correctness.rationale: Reconstructed from the six quadratic residues mod13 the 598 simplices with f=(13,78,221,195,78,13). Independently read the complete certificate.json and verified every one of 227 elementary free-face collapses against the mutable face set; after collapses f=(13,59,72), all 12 spanning-tree edges give a tree, and 47 unit-generator triangle relations successively kill every remaining fundamental-group edge, proving pi1=1. Euler characteristic 26 then gives integral H2=Z25; simply connected 2-complex plus Hurewicz and homological Whitehead establishes wedge25 S2. Independently enumerated all 78 affine symmetries on the *original* oriented complex using signed fixed-face Lefschetz sums; observed character distribution 25 once,-1 twelve times,+1 sixty-five times, matching 2(#fixed vertices)-1 and therefore rational W⊕augmentation module. No equivariant collapse or integral representation splitting is asserted.
